articles.title: Knowledge Catalog で AI エージェントに社内の知識を渡す基盤づくり – ミッション型インターン体験記
articles.topic: AIエージェントの知識と権限境界
articles.accessNote: Read the public original narrative, tables and relevant implementation examples. Publication time checked against its time element or JSON-LD; experiments not independently executed.
verifiedFacts: AI POS uses Cloud Run worker tools rather than direct agent database access; knowledge is represented as OKF Markdown with YAML frontmatter.
Custom-entry catalogViewer visibility is project scoped, not an entry-group tenant boundary; the worker fixes retrieval scope and only exposes search terms/count.
Author observed Japanese keyword variants missing matches and semantic results including irrelevant entries; no exhaustive retrieval guarantee or benchmark accuracy was established.

articles.title: 22 分の録音文字起こしを 25 分 → 33 秒にした
articles.topic: 音声処理の計測とCPU・GPU資源配分
articles.accessNote: Read the public original narrative, tables and relevant implementation examples. Publication time checked against its time element or JSON-LD; experiments not independently executed.
verifiedFacts: On the author's Mac high-speed path, a 22-minute recording changed from 10–25 minutes to 33 seconds; this is a local application measurement, not a universal ASR speed ratio.
CPU diarization and GPU mlx-whisper transcription used separate processes; reserving two CPU cores avoided CPU starvation of GPU orchestration.
Bypassing unused sherpa-onnx embedding work reduced diarization; short audio quantization gains did not carry to the 22-minute input.

articles.title: Playwright CLI 0.1.23の--isolated-contextで、1つのセッションに2人分のログイン状態を持たせる
articles.topic: 複数ユーザーのブラウザテスト
articles.accessNote: Read the public original narrative, tables and relevant implementation examples. Publication time checked against its time element or JSON-LD; experiments not independently executed.
verifiedFacts: CLI 0.1.23 named contexts separate cookies/localStorage; repeated context names reuse login state within one session.
Named contexts survived closing their tabs but did not survive closing the session, including the tested persistent profile; state-save/load restored authentication explicitly.
Network routes and device emulation remained session wide; different accounts do not imply independent mocks or device settings. MCP and trace content/video were not tested.

articles.title: Amazon EMR Serverless の事前初期化容量で、ジョブが開始されるまでの時間をジョブの間隔ごとに測ってみた
articles.topic: 事前初期化容量とジョブ開始時間
articles.accessNote: Read the public original narrative, tables and relevant implementation examples. Publication time checked against its time element or JSON-LD; experiments not independently executed.
verifiedFacts: Tokyo emr-7.9.0 ARM64 used one driver and one executor, each 1 vCPU/2GB, with maximum capacity equal to preinitialized capacity.
With STARTED application and at least 120 seconds after the preceding job, startup was 4.2–7.6 seconds versus 77.6–80.0 without preinitialization. Immediate reuse remained 74.2–77.6 seconds.

CloudWatch PendingCreation supported the worker recreation interpretation; metrics were one-minute granularity, request polling roughly 1.2-second uncertainty; tiny condition counts and no full cost comparison.

articles.title: [アップデート] AWS Glue ETL ジョブで Glue バージョンに Auto を指定できるようになったので、5.1 から 6.0 への自動アップグレードを試してみた
articles.topic: ETLの自動移行と検証の副作用
articles.accessNote: Read the public original narrative, tables and relevant implementation examples. Publication time checked against its time element or JSON-LD; experiments not independently executed.
verifiedFacts: Existing Glue5.1 Spark ETL job changed to Auto, observed three old-version runs, waited for consent, then tested three Glue6.0 production-path executions before completion.
Tokyo test aggregated twenty CSV rows into five Parquet rows with two G.1X workers; output matched this baseline. Auto did not rewrite the script.
Approval precedes new-version runs; fallback can append duplicate output, so Write Paths and downstream idempotency matter. The failure/fallback branch was not exercised.
GlueVersion remains auto; actual runtime must be read per JobRun/AutoUpgradeMetadata; this example is not evidence that every job is compatible.
